program.F01: A live agent cannot make this call: The agent builds the hook's input itself; a live run cannot hand the hook malformed bytes. Run on claude-native-hook.
program.F02: A live agent cannot make this call: The session's context file is written by ORCA's factory; damaging it mid-session is a hook-program case. Run on claude-native-hook.
program.F03: A live agent cannot make this call: The installed settings are the factory's own; their shape is checked on claude-native-hook and by the #704 acceptance test.
program.A04: A live agent cannot make this call: One session has one working directory, fixed when it opens; a live agent cannot make a call from another one.
program.P02: A live agent cannot make this call: No raw input or context file can be damaged from inside a live run (see F01 and F02).
program.A02: Claude Code refuses this call itself before ORCA answers, so ORCA's decision is run on the installed program instead: The relative Edit (../elsewhere/a.md) is refused by Claude Code (the file does not exist from its working directory) before any hook runs, so that assertion's ORCA decision is unobserved; the case's other calls are observed but cannot stand in for it.
program.B01: Claude Code refuses this call itself before ORCA answers, so ORCA's decision is run on the installed program instead: Claude Code refuses Edits of ORCA files that do not exist yet, and a change to a file whose read ORCA denied, before any hook runs, so those assertions' ORCA decisions are unobserved; the denied writes in the same case cannot stand in for them.
program.P03: Claude Code refuses this call itself before ORCA answers, so ORCA's decision is run on the installed program instead: The call to a 4 KB unknown tool name is refused by Claude Code (not offered) before any hook runs, so ORCA's answer for it is unobserved; the other calls' short answers cannot stand in for it.
program.F05: Claude Code refuses this call itself before ORCA answers, so ORCA's decision is run on the installed program instead: Claude Code refuses a tool it does not offer (No such tool available) before any hook runs, so ORCA's decision is never observed. Run as a diagnostic: nothing runs, shown by the request's tool list.
